source_change_after_previous_staging_evi.scope: Remove one duplicate preseance normalization key from the Virtual Sande Worker source.

invalidation_rule: Any later change to the Virtual Sande Worker source, staging configuration, compatibility contract, or required runtime bindings invalidates this exact-candidate certification and requires a new staging recertification.
next_gate_after_success: Resolve production target, rollback target, protected production environment, CORS origins, and explicit written repository-owner approval. Production remains blocked until every gate is resolved.
safety_boundary: This ledger records staging certification only. It authorizes no production deployment, route, domain, secret, KV, D1, binding, or frontend change.
